observations: Photo 0 and photo 1 show one large industrial machine with teal cast frames and cream sheet-metal covers, standing on a concrete floor in a workshop.
On top is a clear plastic safety guard over a row of needle and hook stations; a saddle arm feeds into it, and a delivery table runs off to the side in photo 1.
The layout (feeding saddle, a row of sewing stations, delivery arm) is that of a thread book sewing machine used in bookbinding and printing.
Photo 1 shows a control panel with coloured push buttons, a red and yellow main isolator switch, a second small panel with an emergency stop, and handwheels.
A small label on the cabinet in photo 1 is unreadable; no brand name or model plate can be read in either photo.
Paint is worn and chipped in places and the machine is dusty; no visible missing covers.
The machine is not running in either photo; no thread, books or signatures in it.
Both photos carry a 'Posted on Jiji' stamp and a dealer watermark 'OYOLAKFOM NIG LTD'.

identity.kind: industrial book sewing machine (thread sewing, bookbinding)
read_from: photo 0 saddle feed and needle stations
photo 1 frame, control panel and delivery arm; no brand or model plate readable

claims.evidence: Neither photo shows the machine powered or sewing; no clip.

risks.proof: One clip of the machine powered on, feeding signatures over the saddle and delivering a sewn book block, with the sewn spine shown close up.

risks.risk: Brand and model unknown, so it may be a low-end or very old machine
risks.proof: Sharp close-up of the maker's plate with brand, model and serial number.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-value book sewing machine of this type

risks.risk: Missing or worn needles, hooks, cams or electrical parts in the control cabinet
risks.proof: Photos with the safety guard and cabinet doors open, showing the sewing stations and the electrical cabinet.
risks.if_unproven: as needing parts and a service

risks.risk: Photos are dealer listing photos with a watermark, so the seller may not hold this unit
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the machine with a handwritten note of today's date taped to it.
risks.if_unproven: condition taken as worst case; agent inspects before money moves

risks.risk: Power supply needed (three-phase) and condition of motor unknown
risks.proof: Close-up of the motor plate showing voltage, phase and power.
risks.if_unproven: as needing three-phase power and a motor check

proof_requests: Clip of the machine powered on, sewing signatures and delivering a sewn book block.
Sharp close-up of the maker's plate with brand, model and serial.
Photos with the guard and electrical cabinet open.

response.reason: Both photos clearly show an industrial thread book sewing machine, so it is priced by type at its worst case as not working, with no brand read. A running clip and a readable maker's plate would raise it.
